name: A
description: Executive functions. Functions characterized by performing a limited number of simple and repetitive tasks (e.g. typing-only roles).

name: B
description: Support functions. Functions contributing to the achievement of a broader mission (e.g. administrative employee, receptionist).

name: C
description: Management functions. Functions consisting of a complete set of tasks forming a single mission (e.g. personnel admin, PC technician).

name: D
description: Advisory functions. Functions focused on monitoring and developing professional processes toward a specific objective (e.g. programmer, accountant, consultant).
Basic execution functions (office assistant, débarrasseur, toilet attendant, distribution of drinks and bread).
Support operational functions (commis, room attendants, kitchen assistants, bar support, logistics).
Skilled execution functions (service staff, porters, grill operators, plongeurs).
Qualified service and crew functions (cashiers, crew, café staff, demi-chef de rang).
Experienced service and technical roles (chef de rang, barman, night auditor, supervisors).
Specialized and supervisory functions (chefs de partie, concierge, sommelier, reception managers).
Advanced technical and coordination roles (maintenance specialists, team leaders, chief concierge).
Middle management and expert roles (assistant managers, sous-chefs, department coordinators).
Senior management functions (head chef, general manager, FO manager, spa manager).
Fishermen - Crew Member (excl. apprentice cabin boys)
